lab_questions.title: Tier-Based API Rate Limiting
lab_questions.description: Basic users are spamming a heavy Video Recommendation endpoint, degrading server performance for Premium users.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Dynamic DRF Throttling
tasks.description:
There is no rate limiting on `GET /api/recommendations/`.

**Goal:** Create a custom DRF `UserRateThrottle` class. Override `allow_request()` or `get_rate()`. If `request.user.profile.tier == 'BASIC'`, limit to 5/min. If `PREMIUM`, limit to 50/min. Wire it up to the `RecommendationView`.

tasks.title: Anonymous User Throttling
tasks.description:
Unauthenticated users are currently completely blocked from seeing recommendations. We want to allow them, but severely restrict their rate.

**Goal:** Change `RecommendationView` permissions to allow anyone. Then, implement DRF's `AnonRateThrottle` to limit unauthenticated users to exactly `2/min`.

tasks.title: Scoped Throttling for Feedback
tasks.description:
The platform needs a new endpoint for users to submit video feedback, which must be strictly rate-limited for everyone to prevent spam.

**Goal:** Create a `FeedbackView` mapped to `POST /api/recommendations/feedback/`. Use DRF's `ScopedRateThrottle` with the scope name `'feedback'`. Configure your Django `settings.py` to limit the `feedback` scope to `3/min`.
